name: Guardromon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait in your hand, 1 of your Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects until the end of their turn.
[Your Turn] While your opponent has no Digimon, this Digimon can't attack.
source_effect: ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
